body:
## Summary
- Require controller runtime pass summaries to include per-observation artifact mappings, not just a non-empty artifact list.
- Reject generic/source/offline-only artifact mappings for physical controller, entitled Host, Mac-side response, and neutral-release observations.
- Update the controller readiness collector to emit retained evidence files and observation_artifacts mappings, while preserving redacted-mode privacy and documenting the stricter fail-closed criteria.

## Verification
- PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_controller_runtime scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness_redaction
- make evidence-tools-test
- make release-tools-test
- PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_controller_runtime scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness
- Manual CLI sample: all-true observations with one generic artifact returned exit 1, verdict=insufficient, can_close_runtime_gate=false
- cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ControllerDeviceHotplugCoordinatorTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ControllerDispatchOrderingTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ControllerInputMapperTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ControllerSessionFeedbackTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityControllerForwardingContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.StreamInputDispatcherTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.internet.InternetControllerSendQueueTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.internet.ProtocolV1ProductCodecTest
- git diff --check

MacHost controller XCTest was attempted with swift test --filter GameController and remains blocked on this host because xcode-select -p is /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools and test target compilation fails with no such module XCTest. No Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI was started, no macOS permissions/TCC/Keychain state was requested or reset, and no adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321 mapping was created.
title: Harden controller runtime evidence gate
